newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end up a notch in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end up a notch in heavy trade.

text.p: Madrid share prices closed a tad higher in heavy trade on Friday, after a bout of profit-taking took the indices off sharp earlier gains, dealers said.
The general index rose 1.42 points, 0.24 percent, to 582.29 and the Ibex added 12.16 points, 0.18 percent, to 6,685.28, both marking historic closing highs.
Key blue chips continued to climb, with Telefonica adding 0.92 percent, and Santander up 2.39 percent.
Construction continued to gain with Acciona up six percent.
"I think we might break highs again (next week) once France's position (regarding the single currency) is clearer after the EU summit" said a dealer at Benito y Monjardin.
"But the rally would have to be strong to break highs well" he added.
Dealers pegged strong Ibex resistance at its all-time high at around 6,740.
Today's release of May CPI, which rose 1.5 percent year-on -year, was bang in line with expectations, and most predict the Bank of Spain will leave key rates on hold next week.
